title: Iskrel Common Signal v1
description: Normalized cross-app signal row for Iskrel Equity, Iskrel GEX, Iskrel COT, Iskrel Crypto, and public sources. Used by Sunday confluence scoring and future Grok weekly routine.

run_id.description: Batch identifier, e.g. ISO week `2026-W48` or UUID from `signals_weekly` job.

as_of.description: Timestamp when the source snapshot was valid (UTC).

symbol.description: Canonical Iskrel symbol (ticker, index ETF, or perp code).

venue_symbol.description: Exchange or continuous futures code when different from `symbol`, e.g. `ES=F` for SPY context.

horizon.description: short: days–2 weeks; medium: 2–6 weeks; long: ~2–6 months.

forecast.description: Signed conviction on the shared +/-20 scale (Iskrel Trend Diagnostics convention).

probability.description: Calibrated P(up) when the source is a classifier; otherwise null.

validated.description: True when walk-forward evidence shows the source beats its baseline for this market/module.

entry.description: Suggested entry price; null when not applicable.

invalidation.description: Plain-language rule that voids the setup (may be tighter than `stop`).

status.description: Freshness of underlying data. STALE/MISSING rows are dropped before confluence, not scored as neutral.

confidence.description: Populated on aggregated ideas after confluence; null on raw adapter rows.

wrong_test.description: Kill test: what observable outcome would falsify the thesis (routine step 5).
